description:
UNFURNISHED Available now. Furnished option available for an additional monthly fee. Please inquire for details.
WELCOME to this beautifully remodeled single-family residence in San Francisco's sought-after Outer Richmond neighborhood. Offering approximately 2,245 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this inviting home blends timeless character with modern comforts, creating the perfect setting for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.
Filled with natural light and enhanced by soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, and tasteful finishes throughout, the home offers a rare combination of warmth, elegance, and versatility. Whether you're gathering with family, hosting friends, working from home, or simply enjoying a quiet evening, you'll find spaces that comfortably adapt to your lifestyle.
Perfectly situated just moments from Balboa Street's beloved cafés, bakeries, neighborhood restaurants, markets, and local shops, this home also enjoys easy access to the vibrant Clement Street corridor. Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, Lands End, and the Presidio are all within easy reach, while nearby Muni lines and major commuter routes provide convenient access to Downtown San Francisco, the Financial District, Silicon Valley, Marin, and beyond.
*HOME FEATURES
UPPER LEVEL
• Sun-filled living room with decorative fireplace and large picture windows
• Formal dining room ideal for family meals and entertaining
• Gourmet kitchen with premium appliances, granite countertops, and abundant storage
• Two spacious bedroom suites
• Flexible den connected to the primary suite, perfect for a home office, nursery, guest room, or additional bedroom
• Primary suite with direct access to the backyard
• Upgraded bathroom featuring a bidet
• Hardwood flooring throughout living areas and bedrooms
• Marble flooring in the kitchen and bathrooms
LOWER LEVEL
• Two generously sized bedroom suites
• Fully equipped second kitchen
• Spacious lounge or media room
• Additional full bathroom
• Direct backyard access from multiple rooms
• Bidet-equipped bathrooms
OUTDOOR & PARKING
• Beautifully landscaped private backyard with multiple areas for entertaining and relaxation
• Expansive deck and outdoor gathering space
• One-car garage with additional storage
• Two assigned driveway parking spaces
*RENTAL TERMS
• First month's rent plus security deposit equal to one month's rent
• Tenant responsible for utilities and routine maintenance of the front and rear yards
• No smoking
• No roommates or house-sharing arrangements
• No pets
• Service and support animals, as defined by law, are welcome
•18-month lease preferred; otherwise, minimum 12-month lease
